name: MiniMax H3 Director (single idea)
description: Charsheet + una idea → video singolo con audio: il QwenVL nel grafo trasforma l'idea in prompt R2VA completo (Director, autoprompting in-graph)

parameters.label: Idea (scenes with timestamps, one per line)
parameters.default:
3 scenes in 10 seconds, one per still, in order:
at 00:00 (S1) is in the villa living room at sunset — warm golden light from the glass wall, standing by the window, serene composed gaze; the scene opens exactly on still 1
at 00:04 (S1) walks along the garden colonnade in the morning — crisp cool light, decisive pace, light wind on her long hair
at 00:08 (S1) indoors at night — blue moonlight from the large window, close-up, determined gaze
Cinematic light, (S1) identity identical in every scene. No dialogue.
